ai_centrality.instructions: Is building, training, evaluating, deploying or researching AI/ML models the core of `job` (not a nice-to-have, not merely using AI tools)?

emerging.instructions: Does `job` describe a kind of role that barely existed in tech hiring before 2024 (for example forward deployed AI engineer, agent engineer, AI evals, model behaviour, AI red teaming), rather than a long-established role?

focus.instructions: What is the main focus of the work in `job`?

criteria.frontier_models: Training, researching or aligning large models themselves.
criteria.ai_products: Building products, agents or applications on top of AI models.
criteria.ai_infrastructure: Compute, serving, data or tooling that AI training and inference run on.
criteria.robotics: Robots, vehicles or other autonomous machines.
criteria.core_software: Software, data or security work where AI is not central.
criteria.customer_delivery: Deploying and adapting technology at customers' sites.
